about_short_description.short_description: Plexe is an automated financial app for SMEs.

product.name: Revolving Credit Line
product.description: A credit line that grows with the business, offering flexible repayment options and limits from $10,000 to $250,000.

product.name: Automated Lending Solution
product.description: A lending solution that combines various working capital needs into one platform, with automated processes for credit assessment and onboarding.

product.name: Accounting Software Integration
product.description: Integration with accounting software to streamline bookkeeping and synchronize financial data in real-time.

product.name: Same Day Payment Processing
product.description: A payment solution that processes payments on the same day, allowing larger payments to suppliers.

product.name: AI-Driven Financial Super App
product.description: A modular financial platform with adaptive APIs, customizable by partners to manage and service various financial modules.
